text:
sam-sales: Quick sync to lock the POC handoff for Meridian Labs. Need: success criteria, data delivery method, SQ checks, and short burst plan. Target window: 10 business days (ingest + ~5k eval prompts).

nina-se: Proposed pass/fail: 1) p95 < 400ms for 512-token prompts, 2) relevance >= 85% on stratified eval, 3) no PII in outputs for blind set. We'll supply scoring harness and smoke tests.

alex-cust: Those targets look reasonable. We'll provide 3k synthetic + 2k masked customer examples. Security insists data be redacted before transfer. Prefer presigned upload to avoid cross-account roles.

infra: We support two flows: (A) presigned PUT into a short-lived Redwood bucket (fastest), or (B) cross-account read-only role scoped to a prefix. Presigned avoids IAM changes; cross-account is fine if they prefer it. VPC peering adds ~3-4 weeks.

sam-sales: SQ item: they attached SQ-7221 asking for client-side redaction proof. Can SEs provide a minimal redactor + checklist?

nina-se: Small conservative redactor (POC-grade):
```python
import re

def redact(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{12,19}\\b", "[REDACTED_NUM]", s)
    return s
```
Run this over CSV before upload. We'll also include a 1-page checklist: run redactor, remove high-sensitivity docs, reserve 20% blind holdout.

alex-cust: We'll do that and tag rows with "case_type" for stratified reporting. We'll hold back 20% blind rows.

infra: For scoring: fuzzy token-overlap >=0.8 + exact-match for structured fields. We'll provide the scoring harness and a 10-sample smoke test you can run locally.

sam-sales: Pricing Q: they need a 2-hour burst window during the POC load test. Sales can offer a temporary reserved node + spend cap. Proposed commercial: $500 setup + $150/day reserved (discounted) + per-token overage after cap. Unused reserved days credited.

sec-bot: Ticket SQ-7221-response created (TICKET-7420). Assigned to security@redwood. ETA: 48h for first-pass.

alex-cust: Timeline: we'll upload sanitized CSV by Tue COB, Redwood ingest Wed, smoke Thu, and final POC report Mon. Any objections?

nina-se: Looks good. Action items:
- @alex-cust: run redactor, create 20% blind holdout, upload via presigned link (we'll send link today)
